adjudication_state_score.name: adjudication_state_score
adjudication_state_score.value: ("adjudications"."state" = 'CHECKING' AND "adjudications"."score" IS NULL) OR ("adjudications"."state" = 'RATED' AND "adjudications"."score" IN (100, 85, 65, 35, 15, 0))

evidence_effective_interval.name: evidence_effective_interval
evidence_effective_interval.value: "evidence_objects"."effective_from" IS NULL OR "evidence_objects"."effective_to" IS NULL OR "evidence_objects"."effective_from" <= "evidence_objects"."effective_to"

proposition_valid_interval.name: proposition_valid_interval
proposition_valid_interval.value: "propositions"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "propositions"."valid_to" IS NULL OR "propositions"."valid_from" <= "propositions"."valid_to"

representation_offset_order.name: representation_offset_order
representation_offset_order.value: "representations"."start_offset" IS NULL OR "representations"."end_offset" IS NULL OR ("representations"."start_offset" >= 0 AND "representations"."start_offset" <= "representations"."end_offset")

scoring_proposals_confidence_range.name: scoring_proposals_confidence_range
scoring_proposals_confidence_range.value: "scoring_proposals"."authority" BETWEEN 0 AND 25 AND "scoring_proposals"."sufficiency" BETWEEN 0 AND 25 AND "scoring_proposals"."directness" BETWEEN 0 AND 25 AND "scoring_proposals"."temporal_fit" BETWEEN 0 AND 25

source_authentications_nonempty.name: source_authentications_nonempty
source_authentications_nonempty.value: trim("source_authentications"."reviewed_url") <> '' AND trim("source_authentications"."reviewed_content_hash") <> '' AND trim("source_authentications"."reviewer_id") <> '' AND trim("source_authentications"."method") <> '' AND trim("source_authentications"."notes") <> ''
